scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructed from explicit recurrence, Jacobian, Schur–Cohn inequality, and local coordinate contraction; finite checker is supplementary. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Local attraction to a nonisolated period-two manifold at P=1; no global attraction or phase-selection theorem. The asymptotic coefficient is for fixed cycle parameter as ring size grows; no uniformity at parameter endpoints.
title: Normal attraction and a diffusive spectral gap for cyclic rational-delay two-cycles
